skills.name: Cleanup AI Code
skills.description: Remove generated cruft, tighten names, simplify logic, and keep behavior stable.
skills.defaultPrompt: Clean up this implementation without changing behavior.

skills.name: Ready for PR
skills.description: Review the branch, run focused checks, polish the diff, and prepare a PR summary.
skills.defaultPrompt: Get this branch ready for PR review.

skills.name: Code Review
skills.description: Find bugs, regressions, missing tests, edge cases, and risky implementation choices.
skills.defaultPrompt: Review these changes for issues before merge.

skills.name: TDD
skills.description: Use a red-green-refactor loop with focused tests before implementation.

skills.name: Merge Conflicts
skills.description: Resolve conflicts by preserving both branch intent and upstream fixes.
skills.defaultPrompt: Resolve the merge conflicts on this branch.
